q1_issues.issue: The fronted temporal "when"-clause is left unrelated to anything: the move event is asserted at top level but no Before/During or other temporal atom ties it to the saying or to the reported dragging, so the "when" relation is dropped.

"across the ground" is put in Location, but the instruction set glosses Location as "in/at/on ..." and requires the preposition actually used rather than a near-fit synonym head for any other spatial PP.

q2_gaps: a simultaneous temporal "when"-clause: only Before / BeforeBy / During are named for temporal connectives and no head is assigned to "when"; here the eventuality it modifies (the dragging) sits inside an attitude seal, and ordering atoms may never cross a seal boundary
notes: The non-factive attitude routing (Experiencer holder, multi-atom complement sealed under And with its own Past), the top-level projection of the definite "the officers" group and "the ground", the agentless passive move with Theme + Goal, and the him -> olvera_carrera coreference all follow the instruction set.
